The image displays a single leaf with numerous small, black, and irregular spots scattered across its surface. Some spots have coalesced into larger, necrotic (dead) areas. The leaf itself is somewhat distorted and discolored. This pattern strongly aligns with the description of Anthracnose, which states, "Spots start small, black, and irregular on leaves, expanding into large dead areas that dry and fall out." The other descriptions do not match. Die_Back involves whole twigs dying. Sooty_Mould is a superficial dark deposit. Powdery_Mildew is not in the knowledge base, but typically presents as a white, powdery substance.
